components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width Inkwell action, one per region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; height: 56px; background: #24224A; color: #FBFBFE; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(36, 34, 74, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(36, 34, 74, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Compact Inkwell action in bars and banners: Drop, Open, Pull one.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #24224A; color: #FBFBFE; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: rgba(36, 34, 74, 0.9); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-pill:disabled { background: #D6D7EC; color: #5A5880; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline and Tonal Buttons
components.description: The Keep and Let go pair under a returned crumb.
components.css: .ds-btn-pair { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-btn-outline, .ds-btn-tonal { flex: 1; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #24224A; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline { background: #FBFBFE; border: 1.5px solid #24224A; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #EEEFF9; } .ds-btn-tonal { background: #EEEFF9; border: none; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: #E4E5F4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible, .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Outlined Ember Red action for irreversible deletes.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: block; width: 100%; height: 56px; background: transparent; color: #B3261E; border: 1.5px solid #B3261E; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(179, 38, 30, 0.06); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header with Count Chip
components.description: Capture-screen header: crumb mark and wordmark, jar count chip, settings icon.
components.html: Crumbs
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #EEEFF9; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-right: auto; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #24224A; } .ds-chip-count { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; color: #5A5880; border: 1px solid #D6D7EC; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-count:hover { background: #E4E5F4; } .ds-icon-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: #E4E5F4; } .ds-chip-count:focus-visible, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Return Banner
components.description: The 'A crumb is back' moment; the screen's one marigold element.
components.html: A crumb is backFrom 3 months ago
components.css: .ds-return { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px; background: #FCEBD2; border: 1px solid #F0C27E; border-radius: 18px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-return-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-right: auto; } .ds-return-text strong { font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #24224A; } .ds-return-text span { font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; color: #8F5400; } .ds-return-open { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; background: #24224A; color: #FBFBFE; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-return-open:hover { background: rgba(36, 34, 74, 0.9); } .ds-return-open:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36, 34, 74, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Layer Field
components.description: Where a new layer is written onto a returned crumb, in Literata.
components.css: .ds-layer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 20px; background: #FBFBFE; } .ds-layer-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #24224A; } .ds-layer-date { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #5A5880; } .ds-layer-input { padding: 16px; background: #EEEFF9; color: #24224A; border: 1px solid #D6D7EC; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Literata', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; line-height: 28px; resize: none; outline: none; } .ds-layer-input::placeholder { color: #5A5880; font-style: italic; } .ds-layer-input:focus-visible { border-color: #24224A; }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: Radio choice in the weekly-crumb sheet; selected gets an Inkwell border.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px; text-align: left; background: #FBFBFE; border: 1px solid #D6D7EC; border-radius: 18px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option strong { display: block; font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #24224A; } .ds-option small { display: block; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; color: #5A5880; } .ds-option[aria-checked="true"] { border: 1.5px solid #24224A; } .ds-option:hover { background: #EEEFF9; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240, 162, 59, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-radio { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #5A5880; } .ds-option[aria-checked="true"] .ds-radio { border-color: #24224A; background: radial-gradient(#24224A 0 6px, transparent 6.5px); }

narrative.overview:
Crumbs is a private notebook read by one warm lamp. The page is Dusk Mist and Lamplit Page, the ink is Inkwell, and the only warm light is marigold: it falls on a crumb when it comes back, and almost nowhere else. The user's own words are set in a book serif and given the most space on every screen; everything the app says is a small, plain grotesque that stays out of the way.

The mood is warm, unhurried, calm, and private. Screens are sparse and single-column, with generous vertical space and one obvious next step. Components are quiet and tactile: soft corners, hairline borders, and tonal surfaces that read as paper and pencil rather than chrome. Nothing pulses, counts up, or competes for attention.

Crumbs must never look like a gamified habit app. There are no streaks, flames, confetti, progress rings, or reward badges.
keyCharacteristics: Two voices: Literata for the user's words, Bricolage Grotesque for the app's.
One lamp: marigold appears once per screen, on the returned-crumb moment or a crumb marker.
Flat paper: depth comes from tone and hairlines, never shadows. Only bottom sheets float.
Decisive ink: primary actions are solid Inkwell; everything else is outline, tonal, or text.
Soft corners on a ladder from fields to sheets; pills for compact actions and chips.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: One marigold element per screen, besides the logo mark. Its rarity is what makes a returned crumb feel like a gift.

rules.name: The Amber Text Rule
rules.body: Marigold is never text. Warm text uses Amber, which passes contrast in light and dark.

rules.name: The Tinted Extremes Rule
rules.body: No pure black or pure white. The darkest ink is Inkwell, and the lightest surface is Lamplit Page.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Literata is only for the user's own words: crumbs and layers. Every label, button, heading, and helper line the app writes is Bricolage Grotesque.

rules.name: The Family-Name Rule
rules.body: React Native selects weight by font family, not `fontWeight`. Use the weight-specific families (`font-sans-semibold`, `font-serif-italic`), never `font-bold` alone.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: No shadows on buttons, cards, chips, or bars. If a surface must separate, change its tone or add a hairline border.

dos: **Do** set crumbs and layers in Literata, and everything the app says in Bricolage Grotesque.
**Do** keep one marigold element per screen, besides the logo mark.
**Do** use Amber (#8F5400) for warm text, never Marigold.
**Do** separate surfaces with tone (Lamplit Page on Dusk Mist) and Hairline borders.
**Do** make primary actions full width and 56px tall, and every touch target at least 44px.
**Do** select font weights by family name (`font-sans-semibold`), not `fontWeight`.
donts: **Don't** add streaks, flames, confetti, progress rings, or reward badges. Crumbs is not a gamified habit app.
**Don't** add shadows to buttons, cards, chips, or bars.
**Don't** set UI labels, buttons, or headings in Literata, or crumbs in Bricolage Grotesque.
**Don't** fill primary actions with Marigold; actions are Inkwell.
**Don't** use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF).
